delights: Keto was genuinely respected end to end — 25 g total carbs, 3.9% of calories, with 'Sledz w Oleju (Polish Herrings)' at 2.08 g carbs and 'Chilli ginger lamb chops' at 4.6 g. Nothing starchy snuck in.

It told me when it failed instead of hiding it: 'Tried 2 recipe(s) for this slot, none fit within tolerance — closest was "Jerky & Pork Rinds Snack Plate" (landed 205 kcal vs a 156 target).' I would rather be told.

Protein landed at 148 g (2.6 g/kg at 57 kg), which is exactly what I want for a lean bulk, and the recipes are real food with real steps — 'Cook bacon until crisp, set aside. Fry or scramble eggs in the bacon fat.'

defects.what: Swapping a slot 400s on the exact candidate the app itself handed me — I had to hand-copy the ingredients array back before it would accept it.
defects.snippet: {"error":"a slot needs at least one ingredient"}

defects.what: Only ONE alternate was offered for the snack I disliked, and it was a dish already on the same day, so the swap traded a duplicate for a duplicate.
defects.snippet: {"alternates":[{..."recipeName":"Bacon & Eggs","matchPct":63}]} — Bacon & Eggs was already my snack #3

defects.what: The day is 293 kcal (12.9%) over my 2272 target — all of it in the three snacks the app admits it could not fit. On a 0.5 lb/wk lean bulk that overshoot roughly doubles my intended surplus.
defects.snippet: Tried 1 recipe(s) for this slot, none fit within tolerance — closest was "Bacon & Eggs" (landed 279 kcal vs a 121 target).

defects.what: Two of my three snacks were the identical dish before I touched anything; after the swap I have the other dish twice instead. The keto snack pool looks like it is two recipes deep.
defects.snippet: snack#0 Jerky & Pork Rinds Snack Plate | snack#1 Jerky & Pork Rinds Snack Plate

defects.what: There are essentially no vegetables in the entire day. I asked for balanced, not carnivore — keto has plenty of green vegetables and none of them showed up.
defects.snippet: Total veg across 7 slots: Onion 46 g, Ginger 13 g, Garlic 3 g, Parsley 1 g

defects.what: Four separately cooked meat mains plus a cooked snack is about 116 minutes of cooking in one day. I work in a mine and train 40 minutes three times a week — that is not a day I can execute.
defects.snippet: prep 29 min + 39 min + 25 min + 23 min + 15 min

defects.what: $43.86 for one single day of food, driven by lamb loin chops and a jerky plate. That is roughly $1,300 a month and I cannot run it.
defects.snippet: "Chilli ginger lamb chops" costPerServing 12.83 · "Jerky & Pork Rinds Snack Plate" costPerServing 6.75

defects.what: Inconsistent honesty after the swap: two slots now hold the identical dish at the identical 279 kcal, but only one still carries the over-target warning — the one I swapped in went silent.
defects.snippet: snack#1 Bacon & Eggs 279 kcal warning:null · snack#2 Bacon & Eggs 279 kcal warning:YES

defects.what: Minor, but a keto user notices: my first meal contains honey, and my second contains cornstarch.

followUp.action: Asked for alternates for snack #2, the second identical Jerky & Pork Rinds plate, then tried to swap the alternate in.
followUp.howItWent: Alternates returned 200 but offered exactly one option — Bacon & Eggs, which was already my other snack, at 63% match and carrying its own 'landed 279 kcal vs a 173 target' warning. The apply then failed 400 with 'a slot needs at least one ingredient' on the very object the alternates call gave me, and only succeeded (200) after I manually pasted the ingredients array back into the request; the result left me eating Bacon & Eggs twice and pushed the day from 2491 to 2565 kcal.

verdict: Nothing I refuse to eat got through and the keto math is genuinely tight at 25 g carbs, but a two-recipe snack pool, a vegetable-free 2565 kcal day it admits overshoots my target, $44 of groceries, two hours of cooking, and a swap that errors on the app's own payload mean this is not a plan I can actually run.
